purpose: Confirm or refute the expected within-dataset fixed-Rater RMSE stress contrast selected in the known probabilistic-assignment preflight, while separating Python MML inference, same-estimand R verification, and FACETS/Python JMLE external calibration.
registration_timing: Registered after the four fresh-Person-vector preflight and its non-destructive FACETS supplement, but before every confirmatory Person vector, response uniform, assignment graph, or estimator fit.

independent_adversarial_review.role: A separate methods reviewer challenged estimand naming, independent-unit counting, sample-size justification, cross-engine validation, FACETS rounding, multiplicity, and failure denominators before this plan was frozen.
binding_corrections: PF1 is an expected within-dataset fixed-Rater RMSE contrast, not Monte Carlo bias and not square-root MSE.
The independent unit is one Person-vector triplet containing gamma -0.8, 0.0, and +0.8, not an individual dataset.
The prior R check verified aggregation only; it did not independently verify the free-SD MML likelihood or optimizer.
Scientific inference and FACETS complement qualification require separate terminal statuses and denominators.

prior_evidence.role: Screening selected candidate diagnostics and supplied rough dispersion. The four-vector preflight checked sign stability and execution. No screening or preflight observation may enter confirmatory endpoint estimates.
prior_evidence.r_limitation: The retained R 4.5.1 evidence independently recomputed endpoint arithmetic from Python CSV files; it did not refit or independently evaluate the Python free-SD MML likelihood.

sample_size_contract.basis: Monte Carlo precision rather than the observed preflight mean or a desired p value.
sample_size_contract.planning_statistic: PF1 screening SD from 10 fixed-Person screening replicates
sample_size_contract.fresh_vector_preflight_caveat: The n=4 fresh-vector PF1 SD was 0.0365336324663099; its two-sided 95% sigma upper bound is about 0.13622 and would imply a wider n=200 expected half-width near 0.019. This uncertainty is handled by an achieved-precision gate, not post-result sample-size extension.
sample_size_contract.tradeoff: R=200 is a registered cost-precision compromise. R=400 would protect the 0.015 target under the highly uncertain n=4 variance upper bound, but is not the selected design.
sample_size_contract.prohibition: Do not use the screening or preflight endpoint mean as a SESOI, planning alternative, or stopping boundary.

data_generating_process.model: four-category heterogeneous-threshold PCM under the same fixed facet truth used in screening and preflight
data_generating_process.person_distribution: For each triplet, draw 80 independent standard-normal variates and then standardize the finite vector to realized mean 0 and population SD 0.8.
data_generating_process.iid_claim_boundary: After within-vector standardization the 80 realized Person values are not an iid N(0,0.8^2) sample. Claims must refer to this standardized finite-vector DGP.
data_generating_process.common_random_numbers: Within a Person-vector triplet, all three gamma conditions select from the same complete Person-by-Rater-by-Task-by-Criterion response matrix. Assignment generation never reads potential or realized Score.

assignment.distribution: Pr(G | fixed Person degrees, fixed Rater degrees, connected) proportional to exp(gamma*T(G))
assignment.implementation: qualified vectorized dense-margin exact DP with connected rejection
assignment.assignment_seed_formula: 26102000 + 3*(PersonVector-1) + GammaOrdinal, where GammaOrdinal is 1 for -0.8, 2 for 0.0, and 3 for +0.8

scientific_primary.role: Confirmatory within-estimator gamma contrasts and registered bias/MSE decomposition.

facets_external_calibration.subset_selection: One PersonVector selected from each of 12 consecutive strata spanning 1..200 with numpy default_rng seed 26103000, before any confirmatory data generation.
facets_external_calibration.role: Same-estimand external calibration only; not a gold standard for MML or CMLE.

independent_r_free_mml.role: Same-estimand free-SD normal MML Q31 cross-fit and likelihood verification, not endpoint re-aggregation alone.

primary_endpoint.estimand_name: expected within-dataset fixed-Rater RMSE stress contrast
primary_endpoint.per_triplet_statistic: 0.5 * [RMSE_Rater(gamma=-0.8) + RMSE_Rater(gamma=+0.8)] - RMSE_Rater(gamma=0.0), where each RMSE is over aligned truth errors for the four fixed Rater levels
primary_endpoint.expectation_scope: new standardized Person vector, response uniforms, and score-blind fixed-margin assignment draws under the registered DGP; the four Rater truth levels remain fixed
primary_endpoint.not_bias: This endpoint is not E(estimate-truth), not sqrt(E(error^2)), and not an estimator ranking.
primary_endpoint.test: one-sample one-sided Student t test over 200 independent triplet statistics
primary_endpoint.direction_decision: All 200 registered triplet statistics finite, mean greater than zero, and one-sided p <= 0.05.
primary_endpoint.terminal_interpretation: DirectionConfirmed and PrecisionQualified are separate flags. A precision miss does not erase the estimate or p value, and no extra triplets may be added.
primary_endpoint.sesoi: not defined; no practical-importance claim is authorized

secondary_family.gatekeeping: Evaluate directional secondary decisions only if KA1 DirectionConfirmed is true; otherwise report effects descriptively.
secondary_family.multiplicity: Holm step-down control across KA2 through KA4 at one-sided family-wise alpha 0.05.

endpoints.statistic: PYTHON_MML_FIXED_SD08_Q31 version of the KA1 per-triplet statistic
0.5 * [estimated population SD(-0.8) + estimated population SD(+0.8)] - estimated population SD(0.0)
0.5 * [OLS slope of aligned Rater truth error on true Rater severity at gamma=-0.8 minus the corresponding slope at gamma=+0.8]

secondary_family.test: one-sample one-sided Student t test over 200 independent triplet statistics
secondary_family.intervals: Ordinary two-sided 95% intervals are unadjusted descriptive magnitude intervals; Holm adjustment applies to directional p values.

outputs: MonteCarloBias = mean over 200 triplets of aligned estimate minus fixed truth
ErrorVariance = sample variance over 200 aligned errors
MSE = mean over 200 squared aligned errors
registered_bias_mse_decomposition.purpose: Expose whether RMSE stress changes arise from systematic Rater error, variability, or both without relabeling KA1 as bias.
registered_bias_mse_decomposition.prohibition: Do not promote Rater-specific or gamma-specific decomposition results into post hoc confirmatory endpoints.

facets_contract.windows_launch: visible BATCH=NO with output-gated lifecycle and WM_CLOSE after stable report and Scorefiles
facets_contract.serialization: one FACETS process at a time under a cross-process lock
facets_contract.prelaunch_path_gate: Fail before launch if specification, report, or Scorefile path exceeds 220 characters.
facets_contract.same_estimand_pairing: FACETS JMLE may be compared directly only with independently persisted Python JMLE on the identical 36 datasets.
facets_contract.all_pair_gate: All 36 pairs must individually pass; aggregate means or correlations cannot hide a failed pair.
facets_contract.measure_precision: Use the registered Umean=6 primary measures and thresholds for numerical calibration.
facets_contract.fit_precision: Treat ordinary FACETS fit fields as two-decimal displayed evidence even under Umean=6. They are never raw parity or downstream calculation inputs.
facets_contract.display_fit_optional_gate: If a displayed fit value d is compared, require the Python raw value to lie in the frozen FACETS rounding interval for d, nominally [d-0.005,d+0.005); a boundary fixture must establish FACETS' exact tie rule before use. No MAE or correlation may average away display-quantization failures.

independent_r_mml_contract.scope: The same 36 hash-fixed datasets used for FACETS calibration.
independent_r_mml_contract.engine: An independently implemented R likelihood/optimizer or a package and source commit whose package bytes, source hash, category map, constraints, and quadrature contract are frozen in the execution registration before confirmatory generation.
required_model_alignment: identical Rater, Task, Criterion, and threshold identification constraints
required_cross_evaluations: R evaluates the Python solution log likelihood and gradient
Python evaluates the R solution log likelihood
both engines report terminal score and constraint residuals
aligned main and threshold coordinates are compared per dataset
Q31 versus Q61 sensitivity is retained per dataset
independent_r_mml_contract.numerical_tolerance_registration: Exact tolerances and the frozen R engine hash must be qualified on retained non-confirmatory fixtures and recorded in the execution registration before any confirmatory Person generation. Confirmation outcomes may not tune them.
independent_r_mml_contract.all_pair_gate: All 36 datasets must pass the frozen cross-fit contract. A mean agreement statistic cannot mask an individual failure.

two_layer_terminal_status.ScientificEndpointComputed: All 200 primary free-MML triplets are endpoint-finite and the registered endpoint artifacts are constructed.
two_layer_terminal_status.ScientificInferenceValidated: ScientificEndpointComputed plus all scientific design, fit, constraint, denominator, and independent R MML gates pass.
two_layer_terminal_status.FACETSComplementQualification: All 36 FACETS/Python JMLE pairs pass the registered same-estimand calibration and provenance gates.
two_layer_terminal_status.dependency_quarantine: A FACETS launch, report, GUI, or path failure fails only FACETSComplementQualification. A parity failure suggesting a shared category map, response encoding, truth alignment, or generator defect quarantines the implicated scientific artifacts pending adjudication.
two_layer_terminal_status.product_claim_rule: The workbench may be described as FACETS-calibrated for this scenario only when both ScientificInferenceValidated and FACETSComplementQualification are true.

triplet_ledger: N with all three gamma datasets
N free-MML attempted, returned, converged, inference-ready, endpoint-finite
N fixed-MML attempted, returned, converged, inference-ready, endpoint-finite
failure_denominator_contract.lane_ledgers: Persist planned, attempted, returned, converged, inference-ready, included, and failed counts separately for every estimator and external engine lane.
failure_denominator_contract.primary_complete_triplet_gate: Exactly 200 of 200 free-MML triplets must have all three finite endpoint inputs. One missing triplet makes the confirmatory direction decision inconclusive; complete-case inference is descriptive only.
failure_denominator_contract.statistical_attempt_retry: No automatic retry of a completed Python or R statistical fit. Preserve the failure and denominator.
failure_denominator_contract.facets_transport_retry: At most two identical-input operational retries for launch/report transport failures; retain every try and bind the same input hash.
failure_denominator_contract.facets_denominator: 36 external-calibration datasets, entirely separate from the 600-dataset MML scientific denominator.

analysis_order: Freeze and hash the Python runner, independent R MML implementation, numerical tolerances, FACETS 4.5.0 executable, tests, and execution registration before generating confirmatory data.
Generate all 200 fresh triplets and verify design, score-blind assignment, response-sharing, uniqueness, path-budget, and denominator invariants without computing endpoint summaries.
Complete all registered estimator attempts without scientific interim summaries.
Build separate scientific, independent-R, and FACETS operational ledgers and adjudicate only dependency-level defects without viewing endpoint direction.
Construct KA1 through KA4 only after all required completion markers and hashes are present.
Evaluate KA1 direction and achieved precision separately.
Only if KA1 direction is confirmed, evaluate KA2 through KA4 with Holm family-wise control.
Report the registered bias/MSE decomposition and all exploratory estimator contexts without estimator ranking.
claim_limit: This confirmation is limited to 80-Person standardized finite vectors, four fixed Raters, fixed degrees, connected graphs, one heterogeneous-threshold PCM, score-blind known gamma values -0.8, 0, and +0.8, and the registered implementations. It cannot identify an empirical MAR or MNAR mechanism, validate a missingness correction, establish universal robustness, prove a practical SESOI, rank estimators, or generalize to other sample sizes, Rater counts, sparsity, graph topologies, Person distributions, threshold structures, DIF, local dependence, or extreme-score regimes.
